requirements.text: Students should be able to see real-time availability of items for borrowing and returning online, while staff maintain oversight for handling exceptions and fines.
Staff should easily access and manage fine records, with the ability to place holds or restrictions on accounts due to outstanding fines.
Students should be able to book study rooms online, selecting date, time, and number of people, while staff oversee the process to resolve conflicts.
Staff should have access to booking history and current reservations to manage double-bookings and no-shows.
The system should accommodate special requests, such as accessibility concerns, allowing staff to track and address those needs.
